items.html: However, he is not a complete man until the four Mochin enter him, in the four years, and are completed at the end of thirteen years and one day. For even though we said that he already has ten Sefirot in the first nine years, which are his seven lower Sefirot and his two brains, Hochma and Bina — nevertheless, only the VAK are revealed in him; but the three Mochin are in him now in potential and not in actuality.
